basis: Section 14.2.9 'Green Manure'; the reference function of a green manure inventory is 1 ha of cultivated land ('As the green manure has no harvested product, its reference function is 1 ha cultivated land'). 'green manure IP, until March' is listed in Tab. 14.9 as the inventory used for potatoes IP and soy beans IP.
allocation: none; the green manure has no harvested product, so nothing is allocated. Each spring-sown crop module takes the fraction of 1 ha corresponding to the area needed for 1 kg of its product.

items.name: mineral nitrogen fertiliser, 30 kg N per ha (integrated production only)
items.quote: organic production is the application of 30 kg N/ha in the form of mineral fertiliser in the integrated
items.per: per ha cultivated land (the green manure reference function)
items.note: the only quantified input in the excerpt. The text names it as the sole difference between the integrated (IP) and the organic variant, according to Walther et al. 2001, Tab. 2. The excerpt does not say which mineral N fertiliser product is used, so the supplying dataset (the average N-fertiliser mix at regional storehouse) has to be chosen by the resolver.

items.name: Occupation, arable, non-irrigated
items.quote: manure was derived using the period from the time of seeding until the end of the month specified in
items.per: per ha cultivated land (the green manure reference function)
items.note: the excerpt states that land occupation by green manure is booked as 'Occupation, arable, non-irrigated' and derived from the period between seeding and the end month of the inventory (here March), but it prints no number, so the amount cannot be taken from this excerpt. Reported with 0 rather than omitted, per the rule not to drop uncertain items; the amount must come from elsewhere.

gaps: The located pages do not contain an inventory table for green manure. Tab. 14.9 only maps each green manure inventory to the spring-sown crops that use it; the numeric LCI of 'green manure IP, until March' is not printed in this excerpt.

Soil cultivation, sowing and mulching machine use (the includedProcesses of the dataset) are described only in words - 'machine usage ... during the winter are included' - with no number of passes or machine-use inventories. Tab. 14.7, which lists the machine-use inventories for arable crops, is on an earlier page than the excerpt.
Seed input and its quantity are not given.
Pesticides are not given (the dataset's includedProcesses mentions them).
Direct field emissions (nitrate leaching, N2O, NH3, heavy metals) are said to be included but no amounts appear in the excerpt.
Land occupation and transformation amounts are not given, only their categories and the method of compilation.

Transport of the fertiliser is documented as distances only (Tab. 14.8: N-fertilisers 900 km barge RER, 100 km lorry CH, 100 km van <3.5t CH, to the user in CH). Converting those to tkm needs the product weight per kg N from Tab. 8.2, which is not in the excerpt, so no transport line is reported.
The dataset's generalComment says 'Inventory refers to the production of 1 kg green manure IP, until march', which contradicts the report's reference function of 1 ha; the excerpt supports 1 ha.
